```{r}
#| title: "Live forecasts: log loss of the ensemble vs the benchmark, per horizon"
#| output: asis
if (has_live) {
  live_tab |>
    transmute(Horizon = as.character(h), Quarters = quarters, `Since` = format(dk(from), "%d %b"),
              `Log loss ensemble` = round(ens, 3), `Log loss benchmark` = round(clim, 3),
              `Live skill` = pct(skill, 1)) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrr") |>
    cat(sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("The track record starts once the first forecast quarters have passed.")
}
cat("\n\nEvery forecast is saved before its quarter starts and never changed, and is scored once the",
    "imbalance data for that quarter is published. A few days of live data say little: differences of a",
    "few percent take months to show.\n")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Live skill so far (lower log loss than the benchmark, cumulative)"
if (has_live) {
  cum <- live |>
    arrange(time) |>
    group_by(horizon) |>
    mutate(skill = 1 - cummean(ll_ens) / cummean(ll_clim), day = as_date(dk(time))) |>
    group_by(horizon, day) |>
    summarise(skill = last(skill), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(h = factor(horizon_labels[horizon], levels = horizon_labels))
  h_colors <- setNames(c("#f97316", "#fb923c", "#fdba74", "#fed7aa", "#2563eb"), horizon_labels)
  plot_ly(cum, x = ~day, y = ~skill, color = ~h, colors = h_colors, type = "scatter",
          mode = "lines+markers", line = list(width = 2.5), marker = list(size = 7),
          hovertemplate = "%{y:.1%}") |>
    chart_layout() |>
    layout(yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%", zeroline = TRUE),
           xaxis = list(type = "date", tickformat = "%d %b", dtick = 86400000))
} else {
  cat("No scored forecasts yet.")
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Latest positions: expected spread per quarter-hour, long above the fees and short below (EUR/MWh)"
if (has_da_log) {
  pos_col <- c("-1" = "#2563eb", "0" = "#cbd5e1", "1" = "#16a34a")
  pos_lab <- c("-1" = "Short", "0" = "None", "1" = "Long")
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (k in c("1", "-1", "0")) {
    x <- da_next[as.character(da_next$position) == k, ]
    if (nrow(x) > 0) p <- p |> add_bars(x = dk(x$time), y = x$expected, name = pos_lab[[k]], marker = list(color = pos_col[[k]]),
                                        hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", pos_lab[[k]], "</extra>"))
  }
  p |> chart_layout() |> layout(barmode = "overlay", bargap = 0.15,
                                xaxis = list(type = "date", tickformat = "%H:%M", dtick = 2 * 3600 * 1000))
} else cat("No positions yet. They are made every morning between 10:30 and 11:55, before the noon auction.")
```


::: {.card title="How it works"}
Paper test, not trading. A day-ahead position without physical power is settled at the imbalance price. Every
morning before the auction the model goes long where the expected spread is above the fees (0.188 €/MWh) and short
where it is below minus the fees. The positions are saved before the auction and never changed.

Energinet expects a balance responsible party to aim to be in balance, so doing this on purpose depends on the rules.
:::

# Method

::: {.card title="How it works"}

**What is forecast.** Each quarter-hour Energinet balances DK1 by activating reserves up or down. The direction
sets the imbalance price: above spot when the system is short, below when it is long. The models give the chance
of each direction and the spread between the imbalance price and spot.

**When.** Every hour for the next 4 hours, once a day after the auction for all of tomorrow, and once before the auction for the day-ahead to imbalance positions.

**Inputs.** Calendar, the spot price, wind and solar forecasts made 48 hours ahead and recent imbalances. For the
next hour also the real-time state of the grid.

**Models.** A multinomial lasso and XGBoost, one per hour ahead, refit weekly. The forecast is their average.
Benchmark: how often each direction happened in that hour over the last 28 days.

**Spread.** Recent spreads of the same direction with a similar spot price, weighted by the direction probabilities.

**Tests.** Log loss and pinball loss against the benchmark, Diebold-Mariano with Newey-West, a calibration chart
and the value of picking a side. They are on the [backtest page](backtest.html).

**Data:** [Energi Data Service](https://www.energidataservice.dk) (Energinet), weather by
[Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com).<br>
**Code:** [github.com/jacobazu/dk1-imbalance-forecasting](https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-imbalance-forecasting)<br>
**Last updated:** `r format(with_tz(Sys.time(), "Europe/Copenhagen"), "%d %B %Y, %H:%M")` (Danish time)

:::
